_meta.description: Golden supplier rankings per (category,corridor) for the offline ranking eval (NDCG@k / MRR / precision@k). ideal_order + graded relevance are the accepted ordering; the eval scores engine output against these.
_meta.note: Independent gold derived from supplier attributes, NOT copied from engine output (see audit/admin/36-ranking-gold-worksheet.md). Banks: criteria-driven — fee_sensitivity=low reduces fee-tier penalties, expat/digital priority=9 upweights those axes, branch_need=medium penalizes zero-branch banks. Movers: service_areas destination-city coverage is the primary differentiator for SG→Tokyo; non-international movers grade 0. Insurance: expat_specialized field added to insurance.json (Cigna/Allianz/Bupa/GeoBlue = true, basis: global expat network, dedicated international health division); others false — wire gives 2.5-pt bonus breaking cluster ties. Insurance was previously non-fixable without the new field (8/10 within 1.2 raw pts); adding expat_specialized is the fix.
